items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: They had two of us playing clarinet, a guy named Marlin(?) and myself.

ctx.x: he knew that I wanted to play, so he just... He shoved me right into it. But I'm glad he did, because at that time, I didn't know nothin'. I didn't know that the clarinet played twice as fast as the trumpet. I didn't have the slightest idea about that, you know. So I'd say, 'Well, okay, if that's what I have to do, this is what I have to do.' So I learned to play the clarinet.

After that, after I really got good on the clarinet, I liked it. I liked the instrument. They had two of us playing clarinet, a guy named Marlin(?) and myself. And I was the best clarinettist out of the two of us. So I figured it was time for me to move and, you know, get to know music. So I decided to split, which I did. I cut out and went to...
